messages:
sara_prod: Quick heads-up — today we're shipping StreamMux + Toolchain v1 to hosted customers (general availability). This bundles streaming multiplexing, function/tool-calling, and a new low-cost quantized model: mosaic-lite-q4. Docs + migration guide linked below. :tada:

alex_platform: Huge — congrats team! What's the rollout plan? gradual canary? config flags?

sara_prod: Rollout plan: 1) 12h internal canary in us-west with traffic mirroring, 2) 48h staggered regional rollout (EU/APAC), 3) ramp to 100% for standard tiers after safety checks. Dedicated customers will be contacted separately.

maria_docs: Docs: https://internal.redwood/devdocs/streammux-toolchain — includes migration steps and sample SDK snippets. Will add a "Migration checklist" section.

sam_eng: Are there breaking changes to the streaming endpoint path?

sara_prod: No breaking path changes. New behavior opts in via model param and a header for muxing: X-Redwood-StreamMux: enabled. Deprecated legacy header X-Stream-Legacy will remain for 90 days.

alex_platform: Any perf numbers for mosaic-lite-q4 vs mosaic-base?

sam_eng: Early numbers from bench cluster: ~2.8x cost reduction on tokens for short-chat workloads, 1.3x latency improvement p50 at 512 tokens. Still validating quality on long context.

jordan_ceo: Nice work—keep an eye on quality regressions. Please raise any eval alerts right away.

maria_docs: Added sample migration snippets to the guide. Example curl for streaming + toolcall: 
```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "X-Redwood-StreamMux: enabled" \
  -d '{"model":"mosaic-lite-q4","stream":true,"tool_calls":true,"input":"Find nearby coffee shops"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate/stream
```

sam_eng: SDKs — we pushed client v2.6.0 to npm/pypi. It adds streamMux: true option and handles multiplexed frames. Please pin test apps to 2.6.0 during rollout.

deploy-bot: canary keys created: canary-usw-181900 — active. See /ops/deploys for logs.

alex_platform: Any quota/rate-limit changes?

sara_prod: No quota changes for now. StreamMux sessions count toward concurrent-streams quota; autoscaling handles burst for hosted but we added a soft-fail fallback to mosaic-base if capacity is constrained.

maria_docs: Note for SRE: Added dashboard panels for stream mux traffic, toolcall errors, and mosaic-lite quality regressions. Link: https://dashboards.redwood/internal/streammux

sam_eng: Ops checklist done (smoke tests green). We'll watch error budgets closely for 72h.

jordan_ceo: Thank you all — please post immediate updates in this thread if anything anomalous shows up. :eyes:
